review.notes: Full review of PDE at 0084802 (Lane G added to main's roadmap). Gate at this head passes every check; depcheck 204 roadmaps, 1497 edges, 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates at the branch pin (Tau Ceti a91d3aa, Mathlib 6b7abb3c) with the single intended sorry warning; #check types of the three Lane G declarations compared with the README; one-tactic probe (rfl, simp, ext+simp) fails on the sorried theorem, so it is not padding. Seeded sample: Fredholm alternative = Mathlib FredholmAlternative.lean:164,221 at the pin; Carleson project repository exists (landing page only); 'Lane A comes first' is planning prose, Lane G's A/D inputs checked item by item. Sources: bauer-pauly-schomburg-2016 fetched from arXiv 1511.06697v4 (strong/weak Lipschitz pairs p.5-6, Lemma 3.1 p.7 for p=2, n=3); groger-1989 paywalled, uncertified. Previous review (of PR #93 at fd8e87f, a different pull request) checked finding by finding: its subjects are either #93-only or main's unchanged text (recorded as inherited P3). Blocking: R01 Lane G cites Set.IsLipschitzDomainWith, TauCeti.W1p.frontierTrace and w1p0Submodule_le_ker_frontierTrace, present upstream (Tau Ceti d96e9ce per PROGRESS.md and the docs) but at neither pin (a91d3aa, 358314d); R02 G.32 asserts a compact self-adjoint inverse for Gamma = empty, where the Neumann operator has the constants in its kernel (route must go through the resolvent). P3: summary Poincare bullet omits connectedness; Lane G targets have no locators and two hypothesis drifts; Suggested.lean docstring stale (A-F) and silent on unstatable Lane G headlines, W1pVanishingOn unused duplicate abbrev, hp unused; inherited on-main defects (GMT prose cycle, parabolic API padding, nonempty domain). Ownership: no other roadmap on main or in the 438 open pull requests owns mixed/Neumann problems or W^{1,p}_Gamma.
